description: This PHP source file defines a 'Tag' model class within a blogging module, including methods for retrieving, listing, validating, saving, assigning, and removing tags associated with blog posts. It interacts with the database and manages tag data, supporting multilingual features.

classes.name: Tag
classes.description: A model class representing tags for blog posts, with methods to manage tags such as retrieval, listing, validation, assignment, and deletion.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields that are language-dependent, typically used for localization.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a tag object from the database by ID, supporting localization.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all tags associated with a specific post, optionally filtered by post ID.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Provides a simple list of all tags with their usage count.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the tag object's data, primarily checks if the name is present.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current tag object into the database, either inserting or updating as needed.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Associates the tag with a post by creating an entry in the post_tag relation table.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the association between a tag and a post.
